reasons.plausibility: The proposed cold spray repair mechanism to avoid hot cracking is well-founded in known principles of solid-state deposition and thermal management, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: It includes a direct head-to-head comparison against fusion-welded repairs under controlled operating conditions, providing a clear path to falsify or confirm the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Cold spray repair for a high-value component addresses a pressing practical challenge and could extend service life, so testing its efficacy would be very beneficial to researchers and industry practitioners.
